concepts.quote: No, b times a is 3 4 / 1 2, so the order matters.
concepts.why: The result b×a = {{3,4},{1,2}} is correct, but the answer shows no products or sums. A bare result with no reasoning is only L1, so it does not reach L4.
The answer says nothing about how the expression c[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j] is evaluated.
